summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term equity indices, evidenced by massive $11.7B in SPX BuyCalls and an extremely low P/C ratio of 0.20. Significant directional conviction is visible in massive SPX call accumulations at the 6000 and 7000 strikes for 2026 and 2030 expirations, totaling billions in premium. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-06-18), which has seen $5.25B in accumulation over the last 5 sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in NDX and AMD, which both show heavy call dominance (P/C 0.06 and 0.22 respectively), and monitor for any reversal signs in IWM, which is seeing heavy put-side dominance (P/C 5.60).
